mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate level above 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, compressing valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day S&P 500 returns is greater than -0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tight labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has a Rank IC with 20-day returns less than 0.03 in absolute value over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a declining industrial production growth rate (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, INDPRO growth rate is not significantly correlated with negative 20-day returns (Rank IC >= -0.03 or p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts (HOUST) above 1900 thousand units indicate robust residential construction, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between HOUST and 5-day S&P 500 returns is less than 0.03 in absolute value over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 200.0 signals elevated inflation, triggering expectations of aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above 200.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong employment growth (PAYEMS) and low unemployment (UNRATE) signal a resilient labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (PAYEMS * UNRATE) has a Rank IC with 5-day returns less than 0.03 in absolute value over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a federal funds rate above 4.5% compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the monetary tightening cycle regime, FEDFUNDS level is not significantly correlated with negative 60-day returns (Rank IC >= -0.03 or p>0.05).
